ITEM 1 | Large heap of finely shredded dark green leafy greens with thin pale green stems and ribbons, some curly-edged leaves, scattered thin orange carrot shreds, slight glossy sheen suggesting light dressing, loosely mounded and holding shape, spreading about 40% of plate on the left-center | 95
ITEM 2 | Thin pale white onion-like slivers with purple-tinged edges, a few curved pieces tucked beside the greens, moist and translucent, about 1-2 cm long, sitting at the lower edge of the greens | 12
ITEM 3 | Cubes of pale tan, matte, soft-looking firm cubes about 2 cm per side with slightly browned exterior edges, three to four pieces clustered on the lower right of the plate | 45
ITEM 4 | Crumbled mixture of tan-brown grains with small pieces of orange carrot shreds and flecks of green, dry and granular, forming a loose mound about 5 cm wide next to the cubes on the right | 30
ITEM 5 | Small pale white flecks and chunks with purple-red edges mixed among the grains and cubes, moist and slightly glossy, scattered on the lower right | 8
